additional_info.subject: RE: ID0462531-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2/S1 313508370043] CU logs check CRM:03056000520
additional_info.body:
Dear Filomena,
I am reaching out from the Technical Support Team in regards of ticket
ID0462531.
Apologies on behalf of our Team for the wrong handling of ticket
ID0460606.
I analyzed the logs for charger
Y2/S1 313508370043
in Pesaro at the timestamp provided. Follow here the results of my analysis:
Sessions under analysis on 08.11.2025 at 16:05:00 UTC and 16:16:00 UTC
Both sessions were performed by the same EV, with EVMAC: a4.53.ee.07.38.89
First session was authenticated on DC2 at 2025-11-08T16:05:18 via RemoteStratTransaction.
EV was connected after 10 seconds, charger entered in Charging Phase P01_Authentication, but failed after exactly one minute.
EV was disconnected from DC2 at 2025-11-08T16:14:54
Second session was authenticated on DC1 at 2025-11-08T16:16:24
EV was connected after 14 seconds, charger entered in Charging Phase P01_Authentication, but failed after exactly one minute.
Both sessions report the same error from our SECC: Error 39 - V2G - message timeout for parameter
V2GDINChargeParameterDiscovery.
This means that the authentication was successful, and the charger was waiting for the request from EV of DINChargeParameterDiscoveryReq. This request is not incoming from the EV, and there charger disconnects after 60 seconds due to timeout.
In conclusion, both sessions failed as the EV did not request the ChargerParameterDiscovery.
I hope I provided clarification to your request. Please let me know if any further support for this charger is required. If no further action is pending from service side, I will proceed to close the ticket.
Looking forward to hearing feedback from you.
With kind regards,

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0462531-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2/S1 313508370043] CU logs check CRM:03056000520
additional_info.body:
Hello Filomena,
I recommend that the customer verify that their EV does not have an outdated firmware version for its EVCC (Electric Vehicle Charging Control) and confirm with their supplier that the communication controllers in the EV are functioning properly.
If the customer is experiencing severe issues when charging with Sicharge D, please collect the following information: vehicle type, model, and firmware details. Forward this information to our colleagues in RC-IT, who can take over the case and determine whether ad-hoc
vehicle integration support
is required.
Hope I managed to reply to your question. Please let me know if you have further questions, otherwise I will proceed to close this ticket.
Thank you and have a nice weekend!
